subject: Temporary manager coverage & performance plan: Samir Khan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: temporary manager coverage and perf review coordination for Samir Khan

Hi Karthik / Marcus —

Quick background: Acme AI requested a short-term transfer of Samir Khan to their account team effective May 20 to support a two-month onboarding project. Samir’s formal manager (Emily) is on leave until July, and People Ops asked if we can designate an interim manager for performance review and calibration purposes.

What I’m proposing:
- Karthik to act as interim manager for Samir (May 20 — Jul 20) for the purposes of weekly 1:1s, performance feedback, and completing the upcoming mid-cycle review.
- Marcus to continue to be engaged on technical goals and project-level updates; Karthik will own the official review and calibration packet.

Key dates:
- Transfer start: 2026-05-20
- Mid-cycle review due: 2026-06-15 (workday review window opens 06/10)

Attachments: transfer_form_samir_khan.pdf (People Ops transfer form), org_chart_may2026.pdf (team chart for reference).

Questions for you:
1) Karthik — are you able to accept interim managership and sign off on the review by 06/15?
2) Marcus — any concerns about Samir’s goal ownership while we formalize the transfer?
3) Laura / People Ops — any additional compliance steps we should complete before 05/20?

Thanks — we’re trying to keep this lightweight so Samir’s workstream isn’t interrupted. If you’d prefer a quick sync, I can set up a 20-min call tomorrow.

—
Monica Patel
People Operations (Manager, Talent Mobility)
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary manager coverage and perf review coordination for Samir Khan

Monica — thanks for the note and for the attachments. Happy to take interim manager responsibilities. A couple of clarifying items before I confirm: 

- Review scope: will I be completing the full mid-cycle Workday entry, or should I submit a manager note and Emily (Samir’s manager on leave) will finalize when she returns? We should avoid double-entry.
- Goals: I’d like a short list of currently active goals that Marcus and I should align on for the period May 20 — Jul 20. Marcus, can you paste the three priority goals into a quick reply?
- Calibration: confirm which calibration pool Samir is in so I can prepare the packet.

If all of that is reasonable I’ll block weekly 1:1s on Samir’s calendar starting 05/21 and plan to complete the review by 06/12 to give People Ops time to process.

On a related note — does this change compensation or any eligibility items? If the transfer is strictly account-assigned and not a promotion, I assume no comp change, but wanted to flag.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary manager coverage and perf review coordination for Samir Khan

Karthik / Monica —

Thanks — I’m fine with Karthik taking managership for formal purposes. For context, Samir’s top three priorities right now are:
1) Reduce LLM inference latency for the Acme integration (action items: kernel tuning experiments, batching policy update).
2) Implement prefix caching for chat routes (delivery milestone 06/01).
3) Documentation + runbook for on-call handling of the Acme pilot (due 06/10).

On compensation: People Ops — if there’s any temporary increase tied to account reimbursement, flag it; otherwise I don’t anticipate changes.

Also tagging Laura: we should ensure the transfer form goes through pre-approval in Workday (ticket #WRK-2219) and I’ll update the project board to show Karthik as the review owner.

—Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@acme.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 07:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: temporary manager coverage and perf review coordination for Samir Khan

Perfect — thank you both. Final notes and next steps: 

- Karthik: please complete the full Workday manager review entry by 2026-06-12. We will mark Emily as "on leave" and Karthik as interim manager for the review window.
- Marcus: noted current goals — they’ll be the basis of the mid-cycle evaluation. Please add short success criteria to the project board by Friday 05/14.
- Laura / People Ops: I’ve uploaded the signed transfer form to the People Drive and created WRK ticket WRK-2219. DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/redirect?e=abc123. Transfer form: transfer_form_samir_khan.pdf attached.

I’ve scheduled a 20-minute sync for tomorrow 05/11 at 11:00am PT to confirm handoff items — invite includes Samir so he’s aware of reporting changes. Samir — please let us know if you have any concerns about the interim reporting structure.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
People Operations (Manager, Talent Mobility)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: transfer_form_samir_khan.pdf, org_chart_may2026.pdf
